ADAPTER_TAG().details: This adapter does not consume relayer context, so it sets the skipRelayerContext flag.      The adapter tag is used by the router to determine whether to include relayer-specific      data when routing calls to this adapter. For SingleCallAdapter, all required      information (the target address and calldata) is already provided in the packedData      argument to singleCall_handleFill, so additional relayer context from the router is      not required.
